content_text:
Roger,
When you are setting up a shot on the Alexa Studio, do you let the mirror rotate or do you park the mirror and only rotate it during recording?
I find the constant rotating shutter a bit distracting as my brain is used to film cameras where the mirror only rotates during recording. However, if I park the rotating shutter while setting up the shot, it could upset the other departments as they can’t see an image at video village.
Thanks!
